page.overview:
Who is Teruhiko Futaba?

Teruhiko Futaba is a Japanese man noted to have good looks.

During a trip, Teruhiko was cut in the shoulder by an Arrow, resulting in a horse-shaped mark.

It can be deduced from Takuma Hasumi and Akari Hirai's different hair colors that he has light hair.

When Akari met Teruhiko, he acted as a calm, withdrawn man who preferred to work alone rather than go to parties. However when talked to, he showed a suave and level-headed personality. Teruhiko also expressed the dream of helping children being proud of their town and its buildings.
